family_lineage_asset.reusable_precheck: For a cross-policy-family scientific object, define independence from source lineage and provenance before outcome access, not from the amount of downstream architectural or training modification. A candidate explicitly built on an already admitted family remains a within-family derivative unless a preregistered lineage rule says otherwise. Require any benchmark adapter, serving path, training recipe, and checkpoint/recipe provenance used for prequalification to already exist in the pinned public revision; an adapter created later by the research team is new engineering evidence and cannot be relabeled as pre-existing family qualification.
family_lineage_asset.does_not_imply: a derivative policy is scientifically useless, cannot be evaluated as a within-family robustness variant, or is inferior; it only cannot satisfy an independently preregistered cross-family minimum by lineage relabeling

reuse_scope.experiment_family: cross-model or cross-policy generalization claims requiring independent families
reuse_scope.failure_mode: engineering novelty or performance is mistaken for independent provenance, inflating the number of independent evidence families
reuse_scope.required_preflight: source-pinned lineage graph plus pre-existing benchmark interface/serving/training/checkpoint contract before outcome access

cross_product_integration_asset.reusable_precheck: When a framework separately advertises support for an environment/robot and a set of policy adapters, do not infer that every environment x policy cross-product is implemented. Require a pinned public revision containing the explicit cross-product adapter, observation/action mapping, serving path, and benchmark-specific smoke or contract before counting the pair as source-qualified. Capability matrices are not Cartesian-product proofs; an unmarked or generic adapter cannot satisfy a benchmark-specific family admission gate by juxtaposition.
cross_product_integration_asset.does_not_imply: the framework cannot later support the cross-product, or that its generic adapter/environment components are invalid; only that separate component availability is insufficient evidence of an already integrated benchmark path

reuse_scope.experiment_family: benchmark/model compatibility and third-family source qualification
reuse_scope.failure_mode: separately listed environment support and generic model support are combined by inference into a nonexistent benchmark-specific integration contract
reuse_scope.required_preflight: explicit public cross-product adapter plus benchmark-specific observation/action/serving contract in the pinned revision

training_semantics_asset.reusable_precheck: A training command is not a complete scientific training contract merely because seed, batch size, step count, and base checkpoint are frozen. Before compute authority, bind the exact source revision and dependency lock, optimizer and full defaults, LR scheduler and warmup, precision/distributed semantics, data ordering and normalization/transforms, validation behavior, checkpoint retention/save semantics, terminal checkpoint label, and restart/resume behavior. Resolve conflicts among README examples, legacy scripts, challenge-specific wrappers, and library defaults by a preregistered source-precedence rule. Explicitly audit zero-based loop/checkpoint labels to avoid off-by-one scientific units.
training_semantics_asset.does_not_imply: the source baseline implementations are irreproducible or invalid; it means the first researcher-authored contract was incomplete until hidden source defaults and save semantics were content-addressed

reuse_scope.experiment_family: source-faithful model training or fine-tuning replication
reuse_scope.failure_mode: visible CLI settings are frozen while hidden source/library defaults or checkpoint semantics remain free, enabling silent run-to-run scientific drift
reuse_scope.required_preflight: exact source + dependency lock + complete train/data/save semantics + terminal-unit rule before model load or optimizer update
